items.title: Joel Dorn interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2007
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe and I’m very pleased to have Joel Dorn with me today... [INTERVIEWEE] Nice to be here.

ctx.x: His list of production credits include the names Charles Mingus, Bette Midler, Roberta Flack and Joe Williams. Joel has been awarded multiple Grammys and he continues to create distinctive music with talented artists on Hyena Records.
Joel was interviewed in New York City on January 13, 2007 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Hamilton College Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and I’m very pleased to have Joel Dorn with me today for the Jazz Archive at Hamilton College.
